# Billing

4 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/billing` | Read a workspace's billing summary |
| POST | `/api/v1/billing/email` | Update the workspace's billing email |
| POST | `/api/v1/billing/sync` | Sync the local subscription row from Stripe |
| GET | `/api/v1/entitlements` | Plan limits, features and current usage |

### GET /api/v1/billing

Read a workspace's billing summary

Plan details (any member) plus the Stripe customer email and recent invoices (owner/admin only — null/empty for plain members). Stripe read failures degrade to defaults rather than erroring.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace's billing summary
  - `BillingSummary`
    - `canManage`: boolean, required
    - `email`: string | null, required — Stripe customer email — null for plain members
    - `invoices`: array of `BillingInvoice`, required — Recent invoices — empty for plain members
      - `id`: string, required
      - `number`: string | null, required
      - `status`: string, required
      - `amount`: number, required
      - `currency`: string, required
      - `created`: string | null, required
      - `hostedUrl`: string | null, required
      - `pdfUrl`: string | null, required
    - `planDetails`: `BillingPlanDetails`, required
      - `plan`: string, required
      - `price`: number | null, required
      - `currency`: string | null, required
      - `interval`: string | null, required
      - `nextBillingDate`: string | null, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `501` — Billing is not configured (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY unset)
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/billing/email

Update the workspace's billing email

Owner/admin only. Updates the Stripe customer's email.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `UpdateBillingEmailBody`
  - `organizationId`: string, required
  - `email`: string, required

**Responses**

- `200` — The mutation was applied
  - `BillingMutationResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
- `501` — Billing is not configured (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY unset)

### POST /api/v1/billing/sync

Sync the local subscription row from Stripe

Pulls the subscription's status/cancellation/period fields from Stripe into the local row. Best-effort: always returns ok, even when Stripe is unreachable or there is no subscription. Owner/admin only.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `BillingOrgBody`
  - `organizationId`: string, required

**Responses**

- `200` — The mutation was applied
  - `BillingMutationResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `501` — Billing is not configured (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY unset)
  - `Error`

### GET /api/v1/entitlements

Plan limits, features and current usage

What the workspace's plan allows and how much of each allowance it has spent this period.

Use `remaining` to pace a batch: a null value is unlimited, and `xPostsPerDay` is the one that binds on the free plan while `xPosts` binds on paid plans. `storageBytes` is a running total rather than a per-period count.

A quota with a rate in `overage` doesn't block at zero remaining — going over is allowed and billed at that rate. On plans with `overage.channels` set, `remaining.channels` is the remaining *included* channels before per-channel billing starts, not a cap.

Authenticates with a workspace API key or a session cookie.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace's entitlements
  - `Entitlements`
    - `plan`: string, required — Plan name. Never null — a workspace with no subscription is on `free`.
    - `status`: string | null, required — Stripe subscription status, or null on the free plan.
    - `unrestricted`: boolean, required — Billing is not enforced for this deployment (dev / self-hosted): every limit is open and every feature on.
    - `period`: object, required
      - `key`: string, required
      - `start`: string, required
      - `end`: string, required
    - `features`: array of string, required — Gated capabilities this plan unlocks.
    - `limits`: `PlanLimits`, required
      - `members`: integer | null, required
      - `includedChannels`: integer | null, required
      - `channelsPerPlatform`: integer | null, required
      - `postsPerMonth`: integer | null, required
      - `xPostsPerDay`: integer | null, required
      - `xPostsPerMonth`: integer | null, required
      - `xLinkPostsPerMonth`: integer | null, required
      - `aiAssistsPerMonth`: integer | null, required
      - `autoEngagementPerMonth`: integer | null, required
      - `storageBytes`: integer | null, required
      - `analyticsHistoryDays`: integer | null, required
    - `usage`: `PlanUsage`, required
      - `posts`: integer, required
      - `xPosts`: integer, required
      - `xPostsToday`: integer, required
      - `xLinkPosts`: integer, required
      - `aiAssists`: integer, required
      - `autoEngagement`: integer, required
      - `storageBytes`: integer, required
      - `members`: integer, required
      - `channels`: integer, required
    - `remaining`: `PlanRemaining`, required
      - `members`: integer | null, required
      - `channels`: integer | null, required
      - `posts`: integer | null, required
      - `xPostsPerDay`: integer | null, required
      - `xPosts`: integer | null, required
      - `xLinkPosts`: integer | null, required
      - `aiAssists`: integer | null, required
      - `autoEngagement`: integer | null, required
      - `storageBytes`: integer | null, required
    - `issue`: `BillingIssue`, required — Set when the workspace has a subscription that isn't entitling — a failed payment, an unfinished checkout, or a cancellation. Null on a workspace that simply never subscribed. `plan` stays `free` either way; this is what distinguishes 'chose the free plan' from 'card expired'.
      - `kind`: one of `"payment_failed"` | `"incomplete"` | `"canceled"`, required
      - `plan`: string, required
      - `status`: string, required
      - `periodEnd`: string | null, required
    - `overage`: object, required — Price in USD cents for exceeding a quota. Null means the quota blocks instead of billing — which is the case for every quota on the free plan.
      - `xPosts`: integer | null, required
      - `xLinkPosts`: integer | null, required
      - `channels`: integer | null, required — Monthly (not per-unit) price for each channel above `limits.includedChannels`. When set, the included count is a billing threshold, not a cap — connecting more is allowed and billed.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
